text.aria-label: Title text 'Coverage by phase of an injected load-shift: 15 and 30 day events, both metering groups, 24-120 h ahead Dot: mean over Primary-events. Line: 95% interval from resampling events. Dashed: the 0.90 target; closer to or above 0.90 is better. Scored against the NRA, an estimate.'
text.tspan: Coverage by phase of an injected load-shift: 15 and 30 day events, both metering groups, 24-120 h ahead
Dot: mean over Primary-events. Line: 95% interval from resampling events. Dashed: the 0.90 target; closer to or above 0.90 is better. Scored against the NRA, an estimate.
